governing_question: Does the TC grade action induce a genuine covariance between Suzuki's localized Weil/screw-function objects at different scales, strong enough to propagate a locally controlled property globally?

W2.citation: Masatoshi Suzuki, 'Aspects of the screw function corresponding to the Riemann zeta-function', Journal of the London Mathematical Society 108 (2023), 1448-1487

theorems.hypotheses: Continuous real-valued even function g(t) defined on R from Weil explicit formula
theorems.statement: The kernel G_g(t, u) = g(t-u) - g(t) - g(-u) + g(0) is positive semidefinite for all t, u in R iff RH holds

W8.citation: Masatoshi Suzuki, 'On the Hilbert space derived from the Weil distribution', Canadian Journal of Mathematics (2025)

theorems.statement: Identifies the completion of C_c^infty(R) with respect to Q_W as a Hilbert space isometrically isomorphic to a de Branges space

W10.citation: Masatoshi Suzuki, 'Weil\'s quadratic form via the screw function', arXiv:2606.09096v3, 23 September 2026

theorems.hypotheses: a > 0 (interval [-a, a]), Friedrichs extension of symmetric operator B_a = D^* G_a D on H_0^1(-a, a)
theorems.statement: A_a is the self-adjoint operator on L^2(-a, a) representing the closed localized form Q_W^a(v) = <A_a v, v>_{L^2}
The lowest eigenvalue lambda_a = inf_{v != 0} Q_W^a(v) / ||v||^2 is continuous in a
lambda_a is strictly positive, simple, with lambda_a = 3/(2 a^2) + O(1/a) as a -> 0+, and the ground state is even

theorems.hypotheses: a > 0, lambda < lambda_a, T_a = A_a - lambda I > 0, completion H(T_a)
theorems.statement: D_a = i d/dx has deficiency indices (1, 1); self-adjoint extensions have real spectrum given by zeros of entire W(a, theta; z), and all zeros of W(a, theta; z) are real

theorems.hypotheses: Existence of choices lambda(a) < lambda_a, theta(a), phi(a, z) such that exp(phi(a, z)) * W(a, theta(a); z) -> 1 / (1 - i xi'/xi) compact-uniformly in Im(z) > 0
theorems.statement: If this compact-uniform limit holds, then RH holds
theorems.notes: Requires lambda(a) = 0 for large a, which requires A_a > 0 for large a, already equivalent to Weil positivity and RH

definitions.screw_function: g(t) = 2 log|t| + C_1 + sum_{n <= exp(|t|)} n^{-1/2} Lambda(n) (|t| - log n) + archimedean_terms
definitions.localized_object: Quadratic form Q_W^R(v) = <A_R v, v>_{L^2(-R, R)} on domain C_c^infty(-R, R) with R > 0

log_test_translation.definition: (T_h v)(x) = v(x - h) with h = K log(tau)
log_test_translation.quadratic_form_action: Q_W(T_h v) = Q_W(v) for single test function v
log_test_translation.window_transformation: supp(T_h v) = [h - R, h + R] (asymmetric shift, not centered)
log_test_translation.propagation_status: NO_PROPAGATION (controls only 1-dimensional translated ray, cross-terms require full Weil positivity)

analytic_dilation.quadratic_form_action: Q_W(S_K v) = tau^{-K} sum_rho |hat{v}(tau^{-K} z_rho)|^2 (evaluates against dilated frequencies, not zeta zeros)
analytic_dilation.operator_intertwining: S_K^* A_{tau^{-K} R} S_K != A_R (arithmetic prime impulses Lambda(n) at log n are fixed, not homogeneous under dilation)

positivity_propagation_audit.case_selection: Case B (Pure rescaling) / Case C (No natural covariance)
positivity_propagation_audit.mathematical_reason: Dilation deforms fixed arithmetic prime stations log(p) into non-arithmetic points tau^{-K} log(p), breaking operator similarity. Coordinate relabeling scales interval and operator simultaneously without controlling new physical domain. Log-translation preserves form on single vectors but cross-grade linear combinations require full Weil positivity, which is RH-equivalent.

compact_uniform_limit_relation.notes: Suzuki Corollary 1.6 requires lambda = 0 for large a, which requires A_a > 0 for all large a. TC grade covariance adds no new control over the large-a limit.

restricted_test_family_audit.candidate_single_orbit: F_h = span{T_{aK} h : K in Z}
restricted_test_family_audit.visibility_theorem: FAILED: Any zero rho where hat{h}(z_rho) = 0 has hat{T_{aK} h}(z_rho) = 0 for ALL K in Z, hence is completely invisible
restricted_test_family_audit.visibility_theorem_local: FAILED: On (-R_0, R_0), Q_W is strictly positive; no off-line zero can ever produce a negative witness in this interval
restricted_test_family_audit.general_conclusion: NO_SEPARABLE_SMALLER_POSITIVE_DETECTION_FAMILY: Any family with unconditionally provable positivity cannot detect off-line zeros; any family detecting every off-line zero requires support large enough to encounter prime stations where positivity is RH-equivalent.

reflected_weil_pairing.shift_invariance: EXACT: Q_W(T_h f, T_h g) = Q_W(f, g) for all h in R

ordinary_gram_pairing.shift_invariance: FAILS off-line: Q_+(T_h f, T_h f) = sum_rho exp(-2*delta*h) |F(w_rho)|^2 != Q_+(f, f)

two_pairing_firewall.enforced_firewall_rule: Never borrow positivity from Q_+ and shift-invariance from Q_W into one object without proving their equality, which requires delta = 0 (RH).

base_specificity_audit.scale_geometry: GENERIC_SCALE_GEOMETRY (dilation window scaling holds for all b > 1)
base_specificity_audit.transcendental_scale: TRANSCENDENTAL_SCALE (tau = 2*pi is transcendental, required for rational grade separation)
base_specificity_audit.period_geometry: FOURIER_PERIOD (2*pi i is the period of complex exp)
base_specificity_audit.poisson_duality: POISSON_DUALITY / GAMMA_COMPLETION (Gaussian self-duality and Euler Gamma functional equation)

exceptional_exponent_rigidity.set_definition: S_tau = {alpha in A_R : tau^alpha in Q_bar}
exceptional_exponent_rigidity.rational_intersection: S_tau cap Q = {0} (PROVED_EXACT from Lindemann transcendence of tau)
exceptional_exponent_rigidity.collinearity_theorem: dim_Q S_tau <= 1 (PROVED_FROM_GELFOND_SCHNEIDER: ratio beta/alpha cannot be algebraic irrational without making tau^beta transcendental)
exceptional_exponent_rigidity.epistemic_qualification: dim_Q S_tau <= 1 does NOT prove S_tau = {0}; it proves exceptional exponents lie on at most one rational line in A_R

two_direction_collision_bridge.details: An off-critical zero rho provides at most one displacement delta. No existing TC mechanism forces two Q-linearly independent algebraic exponents into S_tau.

rational_grade_algebraic_noncollision.theorem: For m, n in Q_bar^times and K, J in Q: m * tau^K = n * tau^J <=> K = J and m = n
rational_grade_algebraic_noncollision.proof: K != J implies tau^{K-J} = n/m in Q_bar. Clearing denominator of K-J gives non-zero integer power of tau algebraic, contradicting Lindemann.

next_theorem_obligation: Derive an unconditional positive factorization Q_W(f) = ||A f||^2 on an arithmetic test space, or prove an arithmetic contradiction forcing off-line zero displacement delta to vanish.
